name: Purple Passionflower
desc: Purple Passionflower (Passiflora incarnata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Passiflora incarnata, commonly known as maypop, purple passionflower, true passionflower, wild apricot, and wild passion vine, is a fast-growing perennial vine with climbing or trailing stems.
